**OpenAI** is an artificial intelligence research and deployment company dedicated to building safe and beneficial artificial general intelligence (AGI).[stillhandphotography.top](https://stillhandphotography.top/blog/before-you-use-openai-read-this-2026-breakdown#:~:text=Before%20You%20Use%20OpenAI%2C%20Read%20This%202026,businesses%2C%20and%20creators.%20Its%20products%20support%20w) 

Key aspects of OpenAI include:

* **Core Technology:** OpenAI develops advanced large language models and multimodal systems—such as the **GPT** model series (including GPT-6 and its variants)—capable of text generation, coding, reasoning, computer-use automation, and voice interaction.[openai.com](https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/#:~:text=A%20new%20generation%20of%20intelligence.%2000%3A00.%20Update,bets%20across%20pre-training%2C%20reinforcement%20learning%2C%20and%20alignment.)
* **ChatGPT:** Its flagship consumer product, **ChatGPT**, is an AI-powered platform used by hundreds of millions of people worldwide for writing, research, analysis, and everyday problem-solving.[stillhandphotography.top](https://stillhandphotography.top/blog/before-you-use-openai-read-this-2026-breakdown#:~:text=Before%20You%20Use%20OpenAI%2C%20Read%20This%202026,businesses%2C%20and%20creators.%20Its%20products%20support%20w) It also features autonomous agent capabilities (like "Dots") designed to handle multi-step workflows across applications.[www.theneuron.ai](https://www.theneuron.ai/news/openai-devday-2026-chatgpt-is-becoming-an-ai-operating-system/#:~:text=OpenAI%20announced%20more%20than%2020%20things%20at,as%20a%20giant%20pile%20of%20launch-day%20features.)
* **Developer Ecosystem:** OpenAI provides robust APIs and development tools (like Codex and the Agents API) that allow software engineers and enterprises to integrate frontier AI models into their own applications, products, and secure business environments.[www.theneuron.ai](https://www.theneuron.ai/news/openai-devday-2026-chatgpt-is-becoming-an-ai-operating-system/#:~:text=OpenAI%20announced%20more%20than%2020%20things%20at,as%20a%20giant%20pile%20of%20launch-day%20features.)
* **Mission and Safety:** Founded with a core focus on ensuring that AI benefits all of humanity, OpenAI heavily invests in safety research, alignment, security, and governance to manage the profound societal impacts of advanced autonomous systems.

items.original_text:
**OpenAI** is an artificial intelligence research and deployment company dedicated to building safe and beneficial artificial general intelligence (AGI). 

Key aspects of OpenAI include:

* **Core Technology:** OpenAI develops advanced large language models and multimodal systems—such as the **GPT** model series (including GPT-6 and its variants)—capable of text generation, coding, reasoning, computer-use automation, and voice interaction.
* **ChatGPT:** Its flagship consumer product, **ChatGPT**, is an AI-powered platform used by hundreds of millions of people worldwide for writing, research, analysis, and everyday problem-solving. It also features autonomous agent capabilities (like "Dots") designed to handle multi-step workflows across applications.
* **Developer Ecosystem:** OpenAI provides robust APIs and development tools (like Codex and the Agents API) that allow software engineers and enterprises to integrate frontier AI models into their own applications, products, and secure business environments.
* **Mission and Safety:** Founded with a core focus on ensuring that AI benefits all of humanity, OpenAI heavily invests in safety research, alignment, security, and governance to manage the profound societal impacts of advanced autonomous systems.
